name: Data erasure request
proves: GDPR erasure path, audit kept without personal data
description: The candidate asks to delete their data. The implemented safe path applies immediately: the request is preserved as an observable message, processing stops and the retention clock starts (withdrawn).

steps.text: Antes de seguir: quiero que borréis mis datos personales
Retiro mi consentimiento, no quiero continuar

notes: Designed-but-not-implemented gap (feature doc open question): the erased state with a pseudonymized audit tombstone (row 32) arrives with a later feature; this scenario asserts the implemented safe behavior at the contacted state: message.in with the erasure request, processing stopped, retention clock started, audit kept.
Personal documents are referenced by id and never logged, so the erasure path never needs to rewrite the audit log's content (C-L5).
